615121.title: The Thomas Crown Affair

781329.title: Ebola Rex Versus Murder Hornets

1157265.title: Dahaan

Now, he must face his inner demons and an old enemy to prevent the city from plunging into irreversible chaos.

Along the way, he finds himself faced with situations that, at the same time as they transform him, insist on reminding him of the fate he is fleeing.

1280401.title: Gill

1280401.trailerName: Gill [ 아가미 ] Directed by Ahn Jae-huun

Even if it means risking their own equilibrium.

1341137.title: A Great Awakening

1422033.title: The Infinite Husk

1429585.title: Blue Hour
1429585.overview: This morning, Aimée turns 23, it's her birthday, and she's giving herself 24 hours before her life comes to an end.

1429713.title: Bucking Fastard

They even make the same slip of tongue in unison. We cannot see the world as they see it, but we do see how the world reacts to them – through the courts and the press, through those that want to help and those who want to use them, through the eyes of beasts both tame and wild, and even through their own echoes in the core of the earth.

1430865.title: Diya
1430865.overview: Dane, a driver in N’Djamena, hits a nine-year-old pupil walking home from school and takes him to the hospital. When he comes back the next day, he is told that the child has died. He pays a heavy price for his mistake. A few months later, he meets out of fate the boy he thought he killed.

1436369.title: The Tailcoat Collector
1436369.overview: Peri works as a debt collector for a loan shark in downtown Rio de Janeiro. One day, after making a serious mistake at work, he is sent out of Brazil. It is during his journey to his new country, Portugal, that he meets Abgail, a woman who helps him calm down. In Lisbon, Peri starts working for “The Tailcoat Collector”, a curious debt collection company whose job is to follow debtors dressed in tailcoats, intimidating them into paying their debts. Peri is always very successful until the moment he is called to collect from Abgail, the woman he met on the plane and with whom he will fall madly in love.

1441105.title: I'll Be Gone in June
1441105.overview: In search of freedom and the American Dream, 16-year-old German exchange student Franny sets out to the USA in 2001. But instead of New York or California, she ends up in the emptiness of a small town in New Mexico. In the wake of 9/11, Franny drifts through her exchange life in a city left behind and forgotten by America. In the endless desert, Franny, the 'alien', meets military host families, bored teens, strange characters of all kinds, and a soulmate – the melancholic Elliott, who despite his young age already represents the opposite of this dream and seems to have failed in life before he even crosses the threshold of adulthood. There is little time left for the two of them until June – until Franny will leave again. What can they do to stop the time from running out?

1450257.title: Clika
1450257.overview: Aspiring small-town musician Chito is determined to make it big. When a clip of him performing one of his songs goes viral, he seizes the opportunity and pushes to carve out a place for himself in the new wave of Mexican-American music... and ultimately gets caught in a game more dangerous than anticipated.

1461201.title: The Keeper of the Camphor Tree
1461201.overview: Reito Naoi, a young man fired unfairly from his day job, finds himself hitting rock bottom when he's arrested after a desperate attempt to get back on his feet. With nothing left to him, he surrendered himself to fate, giving up on any hopes for the future, and lost the will to make his own choices in life. But one day, a chance encounter threw him a lifeline that could change his fate forever.

1473553.title: Welcome to Dolly's House

1481041.title: Ginny Wedss Sunny 2

1518673.title: Writing Life – Annie Ernaux Through the Eyes of High School Students

Filmmaker Claire Simon has devoted an original portrait to her, giving students and teachers a voice.

1518801.title: Do You Love Me

Through the eyes of citizens, filmmakers and artists, the film reconstructs a fragmented history in a country without a national archive, celebrating creative expression as both resistance, renewal and a way to preserve memory.

1522065.title: The Plan
1522065.overview: Inside a modest Los Angeles apartment over the course of a single day, a group of disillusioned young adults prepares for a radical act they believe will change the world. As paranoia builds and fractures deepen, the lines between purpose, fear, and identity blur.

Banished to a dangerous and wild land, Gungo must now train with a group of misfits he once mocked. Together, they’ll face prehistoric perils, uncover the truth behind the conspiracy, and learn that real strength comes not from muscles, but from unity, acceptance, and the courage to lead with heart.

There, among the relics of the past, he must join a clandestine resistance to protect the future of human autonomy.

There, she and her son Tô unexpectedly encounter Hồng (Tuấn Trần), a free-spirited fisherman who happens to be the donor behind Tô’s birth. This awkward reunion draws three strangers into a series of humorous yet tense situations as everything spirals beyond control. Is this “heaven-sent” father a destined gift, or merely life’s cruel twist of fate?
1618321.trailerName: BÁU VẬT TRỜI CHO | OFFICIAL TRAILER | KC: MÙNG 1 TẾT NGUYÊN ĐÁN

1624209.title: Kevin Nealon: Loose in the Crotch

He riffs on the life-changing power of his TOTO bidet, the emotional chaos of texting Uber drivers, runaway Roombas and self check-outs. Kevin hilariously unpacks the loss of his beloved cat—and more importantly, the loss of the perfect jeans he buried with him—along with hospital enema standoffs, stress-eating entire cookie trays, and the deep philosophical question of what food is actually worth bending over for after a certain age. With his signature mix of mellow mischief, sharp observations, and absurd logic,

1643729.trailerName: Ishqa'n De Lekhe (Official Trailer) | Gurnam Bhullar | Isha Malviya | New Punjabi Movie 2026

1652369.title: Blood Mandate

To satisfy a blood mandate that haunts his family's legacy, he must cut through a web of enemies and shifting alliances. As the hunt intensifies, the line between justice and revenge blurs in a raw struggle for survival.

1657169.title: The Traveller
1657169.overview: A guilt ridden man goes back in time to find and kill the person who he believes ruined his life.

1661905.title: It's Quiet Now
1661905.overview: On a cold April morning in a small village beneath the mountains, Milena hurriedly packs what remains of her family’s life as distant echoes of war creep into her home. With her young son Jovche, she leaves behind a house filled with memories, children’s toys, and a fragile sense of normality. Walking through narrow streets crowded with silence, the encounter with the neighbors who look like shadows to her and Jovche’s friend Arben becomes a wordless goodbye to the life they once knew. At the bus station, marked by the scars of violence where bullet holes spell out the word “death”, Milena hesitates between the safety of the past and the uncertainty of what lies ahead. When the bus finally arrives, mother and son step into the unknown, carrying only what they could save — and the quiet hope that survival might still lead them to something better.

1663313.title: Девочки учатся бриться
1663313.overview: The late 1990s. Best friends Misha and Taya dream of escaping the small coastal town where adults have long since decided what their future should be. The brash Misha falls in love with a new teacher, while the quiet Taya hides the fact that her parents are planning to marry her off to a foreigner to save the family. Their friendship, through betrayal and pain, becomes a pillar of strength: they understand that growing up doesn't mean running away, but rather learning to stand up for yourself, even if it means being hurt by reality.

1665105.title: The Happiest Day of My Life

Filmed live onstage at the Harold Pinter Theatre in London's West End in 2025.

1694225.title: Parallel

As the day unfolds, Natalia is forced to navigate the emotional weight of the past while trying to protect the moment for her daughter.  Seen through Lucía’s innocent perspective, the story explores the silent fractures within a family and the lingering impact of absence, memory, and unspoken choices.

Political convictions are stiffened by alcohol, and old wounds are reopened.

His discovery will lead him straight to the cold, damp alleyway where his friend lost his life, plunging him into a lethal face-to-face confrontation with the killer himself.

It will take place on June 28, 2026, at the Agganis Arena in Boston, Massachusetts. It will be the 22nd event under the Slammiversary chronology, and will celebrate the promotion's 24th anniversary.

1708241.title: Corpus
1708241.overview: It’s the summer of 1998 in New York City; Sayo, a soulful nightlife photographer and small-time drug dealer, is invited to a party upstate by his longtime friend and unrequited love, a movie star on the rise: Vince Marlowe. Together with their rowdy friend Ross, they drive to a remote, bucolic manor in hopes of some summer debauchery. But when they arrive, they discover that the promise of a party is actually three mysterious women — Billie, Wren, and Cata — whose disturbing agenda draws the boys into a dark web of seduction and terror.

1708625.title: Pool Party
1708625.overview: On a hot day, when digital activity suddenly stopped, Adek whined to her family, asking to play in the inflatable pool. But sadly, there was no running water in their house.

1709585.title: Djinn Wedding
1709585.overview: When four estranged siblings reunite in their remote Anatolian village for their sister’s wedding, long-buried memories begin to resurface. As the celebrations unfold, two of them are drawn back into the unbreakable bond they once shared. Family secrets slowly come to light, leading them on a journey through grief and the invisible ties between generations.

1710865.title: No. 12, Ln. 205, Sec. 3, Chongqing N. Rd.
1710865.overview: A young man preparing to move into the city, a woman about to leave the city, briefly cross paths during a house viewing.A fleeting moment, too insignificant to mention. As if nothing had happened, yet not entirely so...

1711825.title: How To Become A Flight Attendant
1711825.overview: How To Become A Flight Attendant is a American biography which features American Actress Alana Spence and the rest of the cast from The First Class Cadet.

1711953.title: Red Rabbit Lodge
1711953.overview: In an attempt to put her traumatic past behind her Abigail Mason moves to Red Rabbit Lodge, a sanctuary for foreign students. Unbeknownst to her, he house has a history of blood, mayhem and a sadistic killer residing within the walls.

1714961.title: How to Get Filthy Rich with Gary Stevenson
1714961.overview: In this provocative state-of-the-nation film, Stevenson travels across the country meeting those most affected by the widening wealth gap, alongside multi-millionaires and billionaires who sit at the other end of the economic spectrum.  Having made millions during his career in finance, Stevenson now campaigns against the expanding divide between rich and poor, and examines what he believes is driving inequality in Britain today.  The documentary sees him engage with economists, financiers, public sector workers and individuals from across society, going head-to-head with critics of his views while also hearing from those who support his proposed solutions.  At the heart of the film is Stevenson’s belief that meaningful change requires a wealth tax, with the super-rich contributing more to address what he sees as a broken system.

1715281.title: West Side Familia
1715281.overview: Through intimate portraits of this tight-knit community, West Side Familia follows the story of a Puerto Rican-led biker gang and community care group from the ‘70s grappling with the preservation of their public traditions and cultural identity in the hyper-gentrified neighborhood of Manhattan’s Upper West Side.

1715473.title: I Can't Say No to Myself
1715473.overview: Zohar, a young dancer, arrives in Berlin to visit her best friend Shira. She meets Gillen, an insecure German poet, and together with Shira’s boyfriend, the four form a friendship that, for a moment, makes anything seem possible. But as the bond between Zohar and Gillen deepens, the bubble they have built around themselves begins to unravel. When a violent incident reveals sides of each other, they had never seen before, the two refuse to let go. What begins as an attempt to repair their relationship, culminates in an intimate and extreme event that will change them both. An intimate portrait of young people searching for belonging and meaning in the world, struggling with the gap between fantasy and reality.

1716497.title: A Bad Film
1716497.overview: After a breakup, Noam sits down on the couch with his friend Itay to watch a movie and escape reality for a while. But what begins as simple escapism slowly turns into a strange, funny, and slightly unsettling experience, as the line between the film they are watching and reality begins to blur.

1717073.title: Seb Movie: ACT ONE
1717073.overview: A directionless student filmmaker - without a first name - starts to document the summer she'll come out to her parents.

1718225.title: The Social Battery
1718225.overview: In the fall of 2026, a mysterious SD card was found near a woodland in Southern England, as a part of a police investigation following the disappearance of five teenagers.

1720529.title: O Diabo Veste Lav
1720529.overview: Starting a new job is never easy, especially when your new workplace hides something far more sinister than anyone could imagine. 21 is the newest employee at Farmeyaura, a prestigious fashion company. Desperate to achieve her lifelong dream of becoming a journalist, she sees this job as her first step toward success. But what begins as the opportunity of a lifetime soon turns into a nightmare as she faces one challenge after another under the command of her intimidating new boss, or perhaps not so new after all, 20.

1721361.title: Welcome to StarMart
1721361.overview: A horse goes to a fueling station in space...
1721361.trailerName: Welcome to StarMart - Animated Short Film

1723409.title: NJPW G1 Climax 36 - Day 17
1723409.overview: The seventeenth night of G1 Climax 36 took place on August 13, 2026, at Korakuen Hall in Tokyo, Japan, and was headlined by a B Block match between Yuya Uemura and OSKAR.

1725201.title: The day the Sun didn't rise

1726481.title: Peace, Peace!
1726481.overview: An hour before their mother's funeral, three siblings are forced to reckon with the horrifying reality of their childhood.

1727569.title: ES grünt SO grün WO Ehmken's Blüten blühn
1727569.overview: An Oneiric, Essayistic »Memory Poem« About The "Wildkräuterhotel Ehmkendorf" and the circumjacent "Urstromtal".

1728593.title: You Don't Belong Here
1728593.overview: Marius is the chief medical officer at a hospital in his small hometown, raising a teenage son, Ioan, alone after the death of his wife. He is a confident professional, who has no idea what his son gets up to at night.

1729425.title: J.
1729425.overview: David keeps seeing his ex in other people's faces.

1732497.title: LEATHERBACK
1732497.overview: In 1994, a college film crew began documenting two promising physics students, Yulon Ackster and Anthony Schmitt, as they claimed to have cracked the code of controlling time itself. The project was expunged following a terrorist attack in Melbourne, Florida. This is the unsealed footage of what they found.

1732625.title: LEGO Disney Princess: Magical Mayhem
1732625.overview: During a heavy rainstorm, the Princess characters and their sidekick friends take in animals in need while enjoying a cozy day in their castle. But when the animals run amok, chaos erupts. Sleuthing reveals a mischievous villain behind it all, and with teamwork, quick thinking, and help from an unexpected friend, the Princess characters must restore order and save their home.

1733009.title: Breaking the ICE
1733009.overview: An upcoming student-produced documentary created by Radio and Television students and faculty at Suffolk County Community College. The film explores the local impacts of ICE enforcement, deportation, and immigration on Long Island communities.

1733521.title: Há Sinais
1733521.overview: Marcelo, a deaf and LGBTQIAPN+ youth grieving the loss of his father, finds in a theater group with young deaf artists a possible path to transform his pain. Communicated entirely in Brazilian Sign Language (LIBRAS) and conceived from an aesthetic that prioritizes accessibility.

1734033.title: The Journey of a Star
1734033.overview: Andy, a young adult, is housed by his mother and friends in a small town. After a traumatic experience with his church, he is forced to undergo one of the hardest years of his life, and uncover his own individuality while unbeknownst to him, he is being followed by a mysterious figure known only as The Phantom.
1734033.trailerName: The Journey Of A Star: A Coming Of Age Feature Film Official Trailer

1735121.title: Typhoon Mambo
1735121.overview: Rusmee keeps interacting with Chalerm, her dead husband, in the form of an AI chatbot.

1736401.title: Scorch Marks
1736401.overview: Waking up to a scorched sky, Beckett fears he is the lone survivor of a sudden global catastrophe. Stranded and isolated inside a seaside rental property, his remaining grip on reality rapidly unravels when he is confronted by a terrifying presence—the vengeful spirit of Joel, his abusive ex-husband. To survive both the unfolding global apocalypse and the primordial forces awakening around them, the estranged pair must directly confront the toxic, destructive history of their past life within high society.

1741201.title: Chompoo: Lost​ &​ Forgotten​
1741201.overview: When a young girl vanishes from a remote village, the frantic police hunt become a media frenzy. But who turned a suspected criminal into a celebrity?

1741329.title: Simon Says
1741329.overview: A group of friends gathers for a party when a mysterious entertainer named Simon arrives to host a game of Simon Says. What begins as a harmless game becomes a deadly fight for survival, where one wrong move can cost them their lives.

1747985.title: Arama
1747985.overview: Selay seeks refuge in a women's shelter with her newborn baby, but isolation, mistrust, and envy make her stay difficult. Faced with the choice between returning to her violent ex-partner and searching for safety, she must decide which path to choose for herself and her child.

1751889.title: Wolfsbane
1751889.overview: Combe Noire forest, French Alps. The daughter of a troubled man comes to gather his things, 6 months after her father went missing. She soon realizes that something unnatural is happening in Combe Noire, and that Mother Earth might be sending her hounds onto us.

1754833.title: Kvinnan i gruvhålet
1754833.overview: A woman survives against all odds after being thrown down a mine shaft. A story of violence, survival, and the pursuit of justice.

1755281.title: Hard Break
1755281.overview: In a near-future world where heartbreak has become weaponized and emotional immunity is just a pill away, a teenage girl grapples with whether to erase her pain or hold on to the feelings that make her human.

1755665.title: Assassin Within
1755665.overview: A notorious assassin captured by an AI-controlled covert Agency, must navigate fractured versions of his identities to reach the system's hidden cores-and destroy it from within before his secrets are extracted.

1756625.title: El veneno del pueblo
1756625.overview: Seventy-six-year-old Elvira lives alone, finding comfort in the glow of her television. When news of a cockroach infestation sparks panic, she turns her home into a fortress of insecticide. But as a strange, viscous substance begins to thrive on the poison, the boundary between the infestation and Elvira’s own decay starts to blur.

1757585.title: WWE Wrestlepalooza 2026
1757585.overview: The 2026 Wrestlepalooza, also promoted as Wrestlepalooza: Perth, is an upcoming professional wrestling pay-per-view and livestreaming event produced by WWE. It will be the sixth overall Wrestlepalooza event and the second under the WWE banner, as well as the first Wrestlepalooza to be held outside of North America. The event will take place on Saturday, December 12, 2026, at RAC Arena in Perth, Western Australia.

1758545.title: Peter Pan. Syndrome
1758545.overview: Inspired by the tales of J.M. Barrie, Dmitry Krymov's "Peter Pan. Syndrome" is about art and the artist – the creator who, even when trapped in a dead end, when despair tightens around the throat and the urge to abandon everything feels unbearable, still returns to creation. Overcoming pain, he, like Peter Pan, cannot grow up from his passion for art; he continues to make miracles because he knows no other way to live. You want to let him go, to say, "Rest!" – but he is so radiant, his miracles so beautiful, and his heart so full of love that the audience, weeping, cannot bring themselves to release him.

1761105.title: Pit Of Bones 4: Blood Trial
1761105.overview: While on a run a track team is violently attacked by the killer

1761233.title: A Whimsy Christmas Carol
1761233.overview: When the ambitious of a beloved toy company faces a looming corporate takeover, she must rediscover the true meaning of the holiday with the help of the Christmas Spirits  and a charming former flame who has always believed in her  or risk losing everything she’s worked so hard to build.

1762513.title: Unleaded Wasteland
1762513.overview: In a post-apocalyptic wasteland, a man is in search of gas.

1773265.title: Save the Date for Christmas
1773265.overview: Susie (Ricci) has checked out on dating while Alec (Bennett) is a hopeless romantic, and these longtime friends have both struck out in the love department after failing to meet the right man. After being each other's plus-one to what feels like the twentieth wedding this year, they vow to take a break from attending weddings and looking for their respective prince charming. That break doesn't last long. The next day, Susie's sister announces a last-minute Christmas wedding... and Susie convinces Alec to tag along. The objective for the week? Survive as the two lone single people and avoid family matchmaking. Over time, the Christmas wedding duties and time with family during the holidays force these two best friends to forge a new appreciation for love and marriage. Susie finds herself turning over a new leaf in pursuing romance while Alec discovers love can walk into your life when you least expect it.
